purpose: Teach: フィート/エアー/クロック/エリザベス/ミスター/ハワード/ルビー/パット

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが米国の地図でフィート単位を解説して下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father is going to explain feet measurements on the US map for you.
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone. Gently introduces the upcoming moment. Soft opening, slight lift at the end like offering a gift to the child.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとエアー、つまりエアフォースのスニーカー磨いたよ
lines.en: Mom — Dad and I polished Air Force sneakers together!
lines.style: Bright, energetic delivery. Quick tempo with clear enunciation on the action words. Eager to share, unguarded joy. Small emphasis on "polished" — proud of the accomplishment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアンティーククロックの音色を聴かせて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father wants to show you the beautiful sound of an antique clock.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost wondering. Slightly slower pace. Soft reverence for the quiet moment being introduced. Pause weight between phrases — savoring what's to come.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとエリザベス女王の伝記映画観たよ
lines.en: Mom — Dad and I watched a biography movie about Queen Elizabeth!
lines.style: Animated, genuine delight. Quick, bouncy pacing. Unforced enthusiasm — this was truly fun. Slight emphasis on "Queen Elizabeth" with natural curiosity about what caught his attention.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがミスター・ベーカーのギタリスト動画を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father is watching a video of Mr. Baker playing guitar.
lines.style: Gently observant tone. Quiet acknowledgment of his interest. Steady pace, almost noting it fondly. No performative weight — just sharing what she noticed him doing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとハワード・ヒューズの伝記映画観たよ
lines.en: Mom — Dad and I watched a biography movie about Howard Hughes!
lines.style: Same energy as line four but slightly deeper — this was a longer movie, perhaps more engrossing. Still bright, still proud to have shared it. Warmth without exaggeration.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが私の誕生日にルビーのペンダントを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — your father gave me a ruby pendant for my birthday.
lines.style: Tender, touched. Quieter than the reflective lines. A moment of genuine warmth surfacing. Slight tremor of affection, not bashfulness — a private happiness she's sharing with her son.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとゴルフ場でパット練習したよ
lines.en: Mom — Dad and I practiced putting at the golf course!
lines.style: Bright, satisfied closure. Quick, light delivery. Genuine pleasure in the shared activity. Slight finality at the end — content, like a full day wrapped up.
